I am writing to raise a serious concern regarding the extremely poor customer service I’ve experienced from your CRM team concerning my flat booking at Runwal Avenue. 1.	Removal of all incorrect interest charges from my account.
2.	A formal and written explanation for the mishandling of this matter.
